name: filter-panel
description: Structured filter panel with collapsible sections and reset/apply actions.
designIntent: Dashboards and directories need a consistent filter surface that works in a sidebar and a mobile drawer. FilterPanel owns section expansion and footer actions while the caller keeps filter values.

props.name: sections
props.description: Filter groups: title, optional description, content and defaultOpen.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting copy under the panel heading.

props.name: onReset
props.description: Reset action shown in the footer.

props.name: onApply
props.description: Apply action shown in the footer.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Section titles open on first render.

examples.title: Deal filters
examples.code:
<FilterPanel
  title="Deal filters"
  onReset={reset}
  onApply={apply}
  sections={[
    { title: 'Industry', content: <MultiSelect ... />, defaultOpen: true },
    { title: 'Revenue', content: <RangeSlider ... /> },
  ]}
/>
examples.description: A sidebar filter panel with collapsible sections.

antiPatterns.title: Don't own filter values in the panel
antiPatterns.explanation: FilterPanel is layout and disclosure only. Keep values in the page or a filter hook so applied filters can be shared with the URL and chips.
antiPatterns.example: // Avoid duplicating state inside the panel

accessibility.implementation: Each section header is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls
Panel title is h2 and section titles are h3
accessibility.userRequirements: Place the panel under the page h1

compositionRules.relationship: Render the panel inside a Drawer on mobile
